steps.title: After Tele-portent on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FireStackDps).

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: DifferentPolarity has (CasterDps,false)).

RegenHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: ConfettiStackSupport).

ShieldHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: ConfettiStackDps).

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: ConfettiStackDps).

CasterDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: ThunderRealOffset).

steps.title: After Tele-trouncing hits you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: ConfettiStackDps).

MainTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

ShieldHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

CasterDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

steps.title: After Tele-trouncing hits you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 6m north-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 6m south-east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 6m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 6m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: After a tether lands on you
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: Stand near waymark A, 9m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Stand near waymark D, 9m west of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Stand near waymark C, the south wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark B, the east wall.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark C, 9m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark B, 9m east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand near waymark A, the north wall.

CasterDps.rule: Stand near waymark D, the west wall.

steps.title: After Bind on you
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: Depends on FireIsStack and DifferentPolarity has (ShieldHealer,false): true & no → near 3 (SE 9m); true & yes → near 3 (SE 9m); false & no → at 2; false & yes → centre.

OffTank.rule: Depends on DpsGetsDifferent and FireIsLie: true & true → near 3 (SE 9m); false & false → near 3 (SE 9m); false & true → at 3.

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on FireIsStack: true → near 3 (SE 9m); false → S wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on FireIsStack: true → near 3 (SE 9m); false → E wall.

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: ThunderRealOffset).

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on FireIsStack and ThunderRealOffset: true & 1 → near 1 (NW 9m); true & 0 → near 1 (NW 12m); false & 0 → at 4; false & 1 → E 2m.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Depends on FireIsStack and ThunderRealOffset: true & 1 → near 1 (NW 9m); true & 0 → near 1 (NW 12m); false & 0 → N wall; false & 1 → N wall.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on FireIsStack and ThunderRealOffset: true & 1 → near 1 (NW 9m); true & 0 → near 1 (NW 12m); false & 0 → W wall; false & 1 → W wall.
